newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline flat, slow, awaits NYMEX for direction.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline flat, slow, awaits NYMEX for direction.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were unmoved on Wednesday as traders took stock after sharp falls on NYMEX on Tuesday.
Eurograde barges were traded at $205 a tonne fob ARA but activity in the ARA region was subdued.

"It has been pretty quiet so far," one player said. "It is difficult to have an opinion on this market until we know where the (United) States goes this afternoon," he said, adding that arbitrage opportunities appeared to be unattractive at the moment.
